block.description:
Sends the backups of a dedicated Appwrite MongoDB database to a bucket you own rather than Appwrite's default storage.

The API offers no route to read this configuration back, so Terraform cannot detect drift, cannot verify what the server currently has, and cannot import an existing configuration. block.description:
Creates a branch of a dedicated Appwrite MongoDB database: a copy that shares the parent's credentials but has its own host and database name.

Branches have no update route, so changing any argument replaces the branch and discards its data. A branch given a `ttl` is deleted by the server when it expires; the next refresh then drops it from state and the following plan recreates it.

api.description: The product API that owns this database.

connection_password.description: The password to connect with. Rotate it out of band; this provider only reads it.

connection_string.description: The full connection URI, including credentials.

storage_class.description: The storage class backing the volume.

storage_max_gb.description: The maximum storage allowed in GB. 0 means the system default.

sync_mode.description: The replication sync mode. One of `async`, `sync` or `quorum`. Only meaningful when `replicas` is greater than 0.

updated_at.description: The database last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

version.description: The MongoDB engine version. Changing this performs an in-place major version upgrade, which cannot be rolled back.

connection_string.description: The full connection URI, including credentials.

container_status.description: The container status for lifecycle-managed runtimes.

created_at.description: The database creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

engine.description: The database engine reported by the server.

error.description: The error message reported when the status is `failed`.

idle_timeout_minutes.description: Minutes of inactivity before the container scales to zero.

idle_until.description: When the database is expected to be considered idle.

last_accessed_at.description: The last activity timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

maintenance_window_day.description: The day of the week the maintenance window starts.

maintenance_window_hour_utc.description: The hour in UTC the maintenance window starts.

network_idle_timeout_seconds.description: The idle client connection timeout in seconds.

network_ip_allowlist.description: The IP addresses and CIDR ranges allowed to connect.

network_max_connections.description: The maximum number of concurrent client connections.

node_pool.description: The node pool the database is scheduled on.

pitr_retention_days.description: How many days of point-in-time recovery data are retained.

project_id.description: The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.

replicas.description: The number of high availability replicas.

sql_api_allowed_statements.description: The statement types the SQL API accepts.

sql_api_enabled.description: Whether the SQL API sidecar is enabled.

sql_api_max_bytes.description: The maximum SQL API result payload in bytes.

sql_api_max_rows.description: The maximum rows returned per SQL API execution.

sql_api_timeout_seconds.description: The maximum SQL API execution time in seconds.

ssl.description: Whether SSL/TLS is required for client connections.

storage_autoscaling_max_gb.description: The storage ceiling in GB for autoscaling. 0 means no limit.

storage_autoscaling_threshold_percent.description: The usage percentage that triggers automatic expansion.

storage_class.description: The storage class backing the volume.

storage_max_gb.description: The maximum storage allowed in GB.

updated_at.description: The database last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

block.description: Fetches a dedicated Appwrite PostgreSQL database by ID.

connections_current.description: The current number of active connections.

connections_max.description: The engine's own max_connections. On a pooled database this is the backend limit the pooler multiplexes onto, not the ceiling a client pool may reach.

database_id.description: The dedicated database ID.

effective_sync_mode.description: The sync mode the primary is actually enforcing. Empty when high availability is disabled or the state could not be read.

health.description: Overall health: `healthy`, `degraded`, `unhealthy`, or `unknown` when nothing could be measured.

project_id.description: The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.

ready.description: Whether the database is ready to accept connections.

index.description: The member index. Read `role` for which member accepts writes: a failover moves the primary without renumbering.

lag_seconds.description: Replication lag in seconds. 0 for the primary, and for a streaming member whose engine printed no numeric lag.

replicating.description: Whether the member is streaming from the primary. False for a primary, which has no stream to report, and for an unhealthy member, which is not probed.

role.description: `primary`, `replica`, or `unknown` while a transition is moving the topology.

replicas.description: Every configured member, including one the backend has not brought up, which is reported as not healthy.

sync_acknowledgements.description: How many standby acknowledgements the primary waits for before committing a write.

sync_degraded.description: Whether the enforced replication is weaker than the requested `sync_mode`.

sync_standby_count.description: How many standbys are registered with the primary for synchronous replication.

sync_state_confirmed.description: Whether the sync fields are an engine reading rather than a recorded estimate. False means no reading was taken, not that replication is unhealthy — draw no conclusion about replication health from it.

volumes.description: The storage volumes backing the database.

block.description:
Reads the live operational state of a dedicated Appwrite PostgreSQL database: health, replication, connection counts and storage volumes.

These are measurements taken when Terraform refreshes, not configuration, so they change between runs on their own. Use them for outputs and checks, not to drive resource arguments.

created_at.description: The creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

replicas.description: The number of high availability replicas.

updated_at.description: The last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

project_id.description: The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.

queries.description: Appwrite query strings used to filter the listing, for example `equal("status", "ready")`.

total.description: The total number of databases matching the query.

block.description: Lists the dedicated Appwrite PostgreSQL databases in a project. Connection credentials are deliberately not included; read them from the singular `appwrite_postgresql_database` data source for the one database that needs them, so a listing does not put every password into state.
